name: terminal-sound
description: Plays success/failure sounds when terminal commands exit.

terminalSound.enabled.description: Enable or disable terminal command completion sounds.

terminalSound.successSoundPath.description: Absolute path to a custom WAV sound file to play on successful command completion (exit code 0). If empty, the bundled default success sound is played.

terminalSound.failureSoundPath.description: Absolute path to a custom WAV sound file to play on failed command completion (non-zero exit code). If empty, the bundled default failure sound is played.

terminalSound.volume.description: Volume of the sound playback (value between 0.0 and 1.0). Note: volume level adjustment is only supported on macOS and Linux (with paplay).
